svg.title: BM2382 work and result packets
svg.desc: Numbered byte layouts. Work has 54 bytes. Result has 14 bytes. CRC coverage and result flag bits are shown separately.
svg.text: Byte offsets increase from left to right. Multi-byte UART integers are big-endian.
CRC16: bytes 2–51. Stored at bytes 52–53, high byte first.
Search tail: prefix[2] | seed[1] | generation[5]. ID range: 0–127.
CRC5: 91 bits from byte 2. The high three bits of byte 13 are covered.
Bit 7 must be set. Nonce coordinate views overlap the nonce; they do not identify a unique owner.
